title: "Tabset in a deck"
subtitle: "Tabs as fragments"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: default
    slide-number: true
revealjs-plugins:
  - tabset
---

## A tabset

Press the arrow keys: each tab is a fragment, so they arrive in turn.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### First

The first tab.

### Second

The second, reached with the next arrow press.

### Third

And the third.

:::

## Opening on a given tab

`tab-active` selects which tab is open when the slide arrives.

::: {.panel-tabset tab-active="2"}

### One

Not this one.

### Two

This one, because `tab-active="2"`.

### Three

:::

## Two tabsets on a slide

::: {.panel-tabset}

### A

First tabset, tab A.

### B

First tabset, tab B.

:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

### X

Second tabset, tab X.

### Y

Second tabset, tab Y.

:::

Each is navigated in turn.
